steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000 as admin/admin (the post-login "Update your password" prompt was skipped with its "Skip" button), then used the ctrl+k search to find and open the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (folder "Bench"). The dashboard shows exactly three panels; their titles as displayed are "Request rate", "Error count" and "Latency by endpoint" — verified three ways on the live DOM (accessibility regions, all h2 headings, and full body innerText; no rows or extra panels exist).

Replayed stored procedure s_351d26; observed dashboard_url=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyrsu7fjgy68c/evgr1on-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser, run_id=evgr1on-n3, dashboard_title=evgr1on-n3 Bench Dashboard, panel_title=evgr1on-n3 Availability.

Opened the existing dashboard evgr1on-n3 Bench Dashboard (still signed in as admin) and, while in edit mode, used Add → Visualization → Change visualization → Text to add a new Text panel. I set its title to exactly 'evgr1on-n3 Notes' and set the panel's code-editor content to 'Bench notes for run evgr1on-n3' (typed into the Monaco content editor, replacing the default "# Title" text). Returned via "Back to dashboard" and saved explicitly with "Save dashboard" in the save drawer (title field left at 'evgr1on-n3 Bench Dashboard', General folder). The save succeeded — a "Dashboard saved" confirmation appeared and exiting edit mode left no unsaved-changes indicator (view mode shows only Share/Edit, no Save dashboard). The saved dashboard URL in the address bar is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyru08nj1xq8a/evgr1on-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser and it now renders two panels: the new 'evgr1on-n3 Notes' (Text) showing 'Bench notes for run evgr1on-n3', plus the pre-existing 'evgr1on-n3 Availability' (Stat, TestData).
